charts.title: Market size of the wellness industry in Europe in 2022, by country (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Wellness industry market size in Europe in 2022, by country
charts.description: The wellness economy in Europe was estimated at a value of just under 1.47 trillion U.S. dollars in 2022. The biggest country market in Europe was Germany, which accounted for revenues of over 268 billion U.S. dollars in the wellness market.
charts.source: FTNnews; Global Wellness Institute Market size in billion U.S. dollars

charts.title: Market size of the spa industry in the United Kingdom from 2019 to 2022 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Spa industry market size in the UK 2019-2022
charts.description: The spa industry in the United Kingdom experienced an increase of over 20 percent between 2020 and 2022, showing signs of recovery after the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic. The market size of the spa industry in the UK was estimated at just over three billion U.S. dollars in 2022.

charts.title: Market size of the workplace wellness industry in the United Kingdom from 2019 to 2022 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Workplace wellness industry market size in the UK 2019-2022
charts.description: The workplace wellness market in the United Kingdom experienced a decline over just over four percent between 2020 and 2022. The market size of the workplace wellness industry in the UK was estimated at 2.72 billion U.S. dollars in 2022.

charts.title: Market size of the wellness tourism industry in the United Kingdom from 2019 to 2022 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Wellness tourism industry market size in the UK 2019-2022
charts.description: The wellness tourism market in the United Kingdom experienced an increase of almost 80 percent between 2020 and 2022, showing signs of recovery after the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic. The market size of the wellness tourism industry in the UK was estimated at just over 15.6 billion U.S. dollars in 2022.

charts.title: Estimated number of fitness and wellness instructors in the United Kingdom from 4th quarter 2021 to 2nd quarter 2023
charts.short: Number of fitness instructors in the UK 2021-2023
charts.description: There were estimated to be approximately 57,900 fitness instructors working in the United Kingdom as of the second quarter of 2023, compared with 60,900 in the previous quarter.

charts.title: Revenue of the spa market in the United Kingdom in 2022, by segment (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Spa market revenue in the UK 2022
charts.description: The spa market in the United Kingdom generated revenues of over 3.7 billion U.S. dollars in 2022. The largest segment within this market was the day/club/salon spa segment, which accounted for approximately 40 percent of the revenues in that year.

charts.title: Most important factors when booking a spa day in the United Kingdom in 2023
charts.short: Most important factors when booking spas in the UK 2023
charts.description: Health spas often provide a variety of facilities from indoor swimming pools and hot tubs, to massages and beauty treatments. In a 2023 survey in the United Kingdom, over one third of respondents stated that they looked at the facilities for things like a swimming pool and relaxation space when making a decision to book one spa day over another. Meanwhile, just under 10 percent of respondents read up on reviews and ratings when making their decision.
charts.source: Good Spa Guide; SpaSeekers.com Share of respondents
categories: It`s about finding the right offer, I`m looking for real value for money

charts.title: Most important features of spas in the United Kingdom in 2023
charts.short: Most attractive spa features in the UK 2023
charts.description: A 2023 survey explored the most attractive features at spas according to respondents in the United Kingdom. Over half of respondents deemed thermal rooms as the most important factor when booking a spa. Meanwhile, 13 percent of respondents wanted the right treatment selection when selecting a spa location.
charts.source: Good Spa Guide; Spa Business; SpaSeekers.com

charts.title: Importance of wellness options when booking a spa in the United Kingdom in 2023
charts.short: Importance of wellness options to spa clients in the UK 2023
charts.description: A 2023 survey explored the importance of wellness options such as holistic treatments and mindfulness classes to customers at spas in the United Kingdom. Just over four percent of respondents stated that they would not book a spa unless there were wellness options. Meanwhile, around 15 percent of respondents were not at all interested in wellness services.

charts.title: Importance of sustainability when booking a spa in the United Kingdom in 2023
charts.short: Importance of sustainability to spa clients in the UK 2023
charts.description: A 2023 survey explored the importance of sustainability to customers at spas in the United Kingdom. Just over one quarter of respondents stated that sustainability matter a lot to them when booking a spa, but it would not stop them if the spa looked amazing. Meanwhile, less than eight percent of respondents stated that sustainability did not matter to them at all.

charts.title: Share of spa vouchers redeemed in the United Kingdom in 2023, by month
charts.short: Spa vouchers redeemed in the United Kingdom by month 2023
charts.description: In 2023, January was the month with the highest share of spa vouchers redeemed in the United Kingdom. The following months, February and March, had a combined total of 22 percent of the total number of vouchers redeemed in that year.

charts.title: Main barriers to going to a spa in the United Kingdom in 2023
charts.short: Reasons for not going to a spa in the UK 2023
charts.description: A 2023 survey in the United Kingdom revealed the main worries and doubts respondents had about going to a spa. During the survey, around 18 percent of respondents stated that they had worried about going to a spa because they did not feel body confident. However, over 70 percent of respondents stated that they were confident that a spa would treat them well in any situation.
charts.source: Good Spa Guide; SpaSeekers.com Share of respondents

charts.title: Household expenditure on health in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2005 to 2022 (in million GBP)
charts.short: Expenditure on health in the United Kingdom 2005-2022
charts.description: This statistic shows the total consumer expenditure on health in the United Kingdom from 2005 to 2022. In 2022, consumer expenditure on health products and services was some 27.3 billion British pounds, a significant increase compared to the previous year.

charts.title: Average annual spending on wellness in the United Kingdom in 2023, by category (in GBP)
charts.short: Annual spend on self-care in the UK 2023
charts.description: A 2023 survey in the United Kingdom revealed that average consumers spent over 4.6 thousand British pounds annually on wellness and self-care. Within this category, consumers in the UK spent an average of 560 British pounds a year on massages.
charts.note: Europe, United Kingdom; June 28 to 30, 2023; 2,009 respondents
charts.source: Professional Beauty; Website (aquacard.co.uk) Average spend in GBP

charts.title: Average annual spending on massages in the United Kingdom in 2023, by gender (in GBP)
charts.short: Annual spend on massages in the UK by gender 2023
charts.description: A 2023 survey in the United Kingdom revealed that men spent more a year on average on massages than women. Overall, the average consumer in the UK spent 560 British pounds on massages in a year.
charts.note: Europe, United Kingdom; June 28 to 30, 2023; 2,009 respondents; only respondents who have massages

charts.title: Average annual spending on spa days in the United Kingdom in 2023, by gender (in GBP)
charts.short: Annual spend on spa days in the UK by gender 2023
charts.description: A 2023 survey in the United Kingdom revealed that men spent more a year on average on spa days than women. Overall, the average consumer in the UK spent 623 British pounds on spa days in a year.
charts.note: Europe, United Kingdom; June 28 to 30, 2023; 2,009 respondents; only respondents who go on spa days

charts.title: Level of spending on spa days in the current economic climate in the United Kingdom in 2023
charts.short: Current level of spending on spa days in the UK 2023
charts.description: A 2023 survey explored the level of spending on spa days in the United Kingdom in the current economic climate. Around one quarter of respondents stated that they were likely to spend less when booking a spa day, while four percent stated that they were not going to spas at all at the moment.
charts.source: Good Spa Guide; Spa Business; SpaSeekers.com
categories: I`m not going to spas at the moment

charts.title: Consumers planning to purchase products focused on mental health and wellbeing in the United States and the United Kingdom in 2022, by generation
charts.short: Mental health & wellbeing product buying plans in the U.S. & UK 2022, by generation
charts.description: In 2022, many young people in the United Kingdom and the United States said they were likely to buy mental health and wellbeing focused products. For example, around seven in 10 surveyed consumers of the Gen Z and millennial variety said they were likely to buy such goods that year. According to the survey, boomers were least likely to buy items for their mental health or wellbeing in 2022 out of all generations.

charts.title: Share of consumers who purchased health and beauty products online or in-store in the United Kingdom from July 2019 to December 2023
charts.short: Share of UK shoppers purchasing health and beauty online or in-store 2019-2023
charts.description: According to survey findings, UK shoppers' purchases of health and beauty products online and in-store changed gradually between July 2019 and December 2023. The share of shoppers purchasing such products via in-store channels generally declined during the observed period, going from 63 percent to 53 percent in December 2023.

charts.short: Most well-known wearable brands in the UK 2023
charts.description: When it comes to the most well-known wearable brands in the UK, Samsung tops the list. The South Korean brand is recognized by 94 percent of respondents in the United Kingdom, just as much as the also first placed Apple. Sony comes third in this list, followed by Adidas and LG.

charts.title: Prospective health benefits for mobile users engaging with health and fitness apps in selected countries in 2023
charts.short: Health and fitness app planned usage reasons in selected countries 2023
charts.description: According to a survey of users in the United States, United Kingdom, and France, connecting more with friends and family was the main reason respondents were planning on using mobile fitness and health apps in 2023. Accessing fitness content and workouts was the second most popular reason for mobile users to plan using health apps, with 30 percent of users in France reporting planning to using health apps for this type of content.

charts.source: Airship; Sapio Research Share of respondents
